item.title: Peacemaker with a warning to annihilate: The major contradictions in Trump's UN speech
item.description: Trump used much of his address to the General Debate of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly to list his achievements, much as he did a year ago when he cast himself as the standout contender for the Nobel Peace Prize. This year, though, the prize went unmentioned. Instead, his tone hardened, with attacks on the International Criminal Court (ICC), the UN's climate agenda and Unesco.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: Karnataka man 'murdered' in UAE, body cut into 9 pieces; wife, son untraceable
item.description: A man from Kundapur, Alwin, was reported missing after last contacting his family in July. His family became suspicious after receiving unusual text messages from his phone, which he rarely used. After his body was discovered in Sharjah, they received a death certificate and filed various complaints. Alwin's wife and son remain uncontactable amid ongoing investigations. Udupi police await official confirmation of the incident from relevant authorities.
item.dc:creator: VINOBHA KT

item.title: UP man kills wife, 2 priests, takes 3 children hostage; shot dead after 7-hour standoff
item.description: A police encounter resulted in the death of Arvind Singh after he refused to surrender during a standoff. During the incident, he was holding his three children hostage, leading to a police operation. Arvind had killed his wife and two priests following a dispute concerning a religious ritual at home. His eight-year-old son was also critically injured and later died from his injuries.
item.dc:creator: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY

item.title: LSR cancels classes, goes online after Kalkaji Mandir gang rape case
item.description: Lady Shri Ram College cancelled regular classes and shifted them online after a 17-year-old girl was allegedly gang-raped at Aastha Kunj Park near Kalkaji Mandir. Police said three men, posing as policemen, allegedly separated the girl from her male friend and assaulted her in a secluded area. All three accused have been arrested, while police are investigating the incident and checking for possible links to other cases.
item.dc:creator: SIDDHI DHARMADHIKARI

item.title: 1980s AI photo trend: Delhi Police warns users of fake profiles, blackmail
item.description: Delhi Police has issued a warning regarding the uploading of personal photographs to unknown AI tools. The authorities indicate that such images can be used for creating fake profiles or fraud. Users are advised to be mindful and avoid clicking on unverified links that may lead to scams. Additionally, individuals who experience cyber fraud should report incidents through official channels.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: ‘Firearms, knife and more’: How 3 men posing as cops turned 17-year-old’s birthday outing into a nightmare
item.description: A 17-year-old girl from Faridabad was allegedly raped by three men in Aastha Kunj Park. After visiting Kalkaji Temple, she and her male friend entered the park and faced intimidation. The men, posing as police, threatened to inform their parents about their actions. During the incident, the men physically assaulted the girl's friend before taking her to a secluded area.
item.dc:creator: ABHAY

item.title: Heavy LHB bogie corrosion worries Railways; toilet leaks, saline air blamed
item.description: Recently senior railway engineers have raised concerns over heavy corrosion in the bogies of LHB passenger coaches, despite the use of materials that are designed to resist corrosion and efforts to strengthen cleaning and maintenance practices.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: 'Almost all agents' data stolen? Hackers claim FBI job site breach, stole 2TB of data
item.description: The FBI is currently investigating a cyberattack on its job application website, FBIjobs.gov. ShinyHunters claimed to have stolen over 2 terabytes of sensitive data related to FBI employees and applicants. The group alleged they accessed information through a vulnerability in Oracle’s PeopleSoft system. Cybersecurity experts expressed concerns about the potential long-term risks for affected individuals if the data circulates further.
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Juggling Chess Olympiad prep and commentary gig in India: The other side of GM Irina
item.description: Irina Krush has been a constant presence in the United States women’s chess team’s rise, featuring in all three of its historic Olympiad medals. From becoming America’s youngest women’s champion at 14 to earning the country’s only female GM title, Krush, speaking exclusively to TimesofIndia.com, reflects on her journey, the changing landscape of American chess, her commentary career, and the challenges of competing at her 13th Olympiad.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: USCIS warns against websites and businesses ‘guaranteeing’ faster visa
item.description: The US Citizenship and Immigration Services has issued a caution about scams that are specifically targeting immigration applicants. Certain businesses are falsely advertising services to speed up visa and Green Card applications by claiming to have special connections. USCIS encourages all applicants to rely on official immigration resources, report dubious services, and follow proper procedures for filling out forms to ensure a smooth immigration journey.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Vaikom Vijayalakshmi’s National Award follows journey through blindness and freedom
item.description: Vaikom Vijayalakshmi has been honored with the National Award for Best Female Playback Singer, a remarkable achievement in her music career. Despite her visual impairment, she champions inclusivity and understanding. As she navigates through her treatment and the aftermath of a challenging marriage, she embraces independence, showcasing her resilience. Her inspiring journey demonstrates how personal struggles can fuel the pursuit of one’s dreams and triumph over adversity.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: 'Stalked, hit deliberately': Delhi woman claims bikers chased her scooty before crash
item.description: A 21-year-old woman reported being stalked and harassed by two men on a motorcycle in South Delhi. While riding home on her scooter, they allegedly hit her vehicle, causing her to fall. The incident resulted in her suffering injuries as she skidded on the road. Police have registered an FIR and initiated an investigation into the matter. CCTV footage reviewed did not reveal the alleged incident or the individuals involved.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: How rising house prices have forced Taiwan to settle for ‘haunted homes’
item.description: In Taiwan, the soaring property prices are leading buyers to consider 'haunted houses,' which come at significantly lower prices due to their grim pasts. Many banks are reluctant to finance these homes, fearing future resale challenges and negative superstitions. Before they move in, buyers often engage in spiritual rituals to honor the spirits, showcasing how traditional beliefs continue to shape the modern housing market in Taiwan.

item.description: In July, Donald Trump showcased his financial acumen with substantial investments, notably entering and exiting positions in Elon Musk's SpaceX. His trading spectrum also included major players like Microsoft and Amazon, totaling over 1,150 transactions, highlighting a well-rounded investment strategy. Furthermore, he delved into several bond purchases and efficiently maneuvered through exchange-traded funds, demonstrating a proactive approach to managing his financial portfolio amid prior activities.

item.title: Malayalam actor Vinu Mohan and Vidya divorce
item.description: Vinu Mohan and Vidya have reportedly divorced after 13 years of marriage, marking the end of their relationship. They had been married since 2013, having met through their connection with the film industry. Vinu has removed pictures of Vidya from his social media account, which has raised speculation among fans. Vidya still retains their pictures on her Instagram, and her account name reflects their previous union.

item.title: IIT-Bombay suicide case: Student's father threatens hunger strike
item.description: Sahil Wakode, a second-year BTech student, tragically died by suicide on the IIT-Bombay campus. Following his death, his father, Ravindra, announced a hunger strike if officials involved are not arrested. IIT-Bombay formed a 10-member committee to investigate the circumstances surrounding Wakode's death and put Prof Suryanarayana Doolla on leave. Faculty bodies supported their IIT-B counterparts, while students expressed their demands and concerns on campus.

item.title: Passport seized, alert issued as cops hunt Kazakh coach accused of raping minor
item.description: A 34-year-old foreign coach has been booked under the Pocso Act for allegedly raping a minor cyclist. The coach, Maxat Ayazbayev, is currently untraceable since the complaint was filed last week. Investigations revealed that the assault took place during a training camp at the National Centre of Excellence on September 13. The Cycling Federation of India has suspended Ayazbayev and initiated an internal inquiry into the allegations.

item.title: Oil prices ease as Saudi restores key pipeline, traders optimistic on US-Iran talks
item.description: Oil prices have dropped below $100 a barrel due to Saudi Arabia restarting crude supply operations. Diplomatic efforts to resolve the US-Iran conflict have also contributed to easing market pressure. US crude inventories increased by 1.8 million barrels in the past week, contrary to analysts' expectations. Iraq is reportedly increasing its oil exports, signaling a shift in regional supply dynamics.

item.title: Why kids talk to toys and imaginary friends: When parents should worry
item.description: Many kids enjoy pretend play with imaginary pals or stuffed toys, fostering their communication skills. Engaging in this type of play is typical and does not necessarily indicate loneliness. However, if children display notable changes in behavior regarding their imaginary friends, parents should take note. Asking about these imaginary companions can initiate valuable conversations and strengthen the parent-child bond, prioritizing the child's happiness above all.

item.title: Vietnam to Colombo flight makes emergency landing at Chennai airport
item.description: During a VietJet Airlines flight from Ho Chi Minh City to Colombo, an alarming engine failure compelled the crew to make an emergency landing in Chennai. As a precaution, the airport activated a full emergency response to ensure passenger safety. Thankfully, all 143 individuals aboard, including crew members, emerged without injuries. An inspection of the aircraft is set to follow, aiming to uncover the reasons behind the engine malfunction.

item.title: Presley Gerber's death case linked to Matthew Perry amid suspected Ketamine use
item.description: Presley Gerber's body was released by the Medical Examiner following his tragic death at a rehabilitation facility. He was found unresponsive shortly after being admitted, and authorities suspect an overdose. Reports indicate he had a history of substance use issues, including a prescription for ketamine. Gerber had previously documented his struggles with addiction and mental health publicly.
